title: WaveResponse
description: The wave worked out from the plan at the head of into: its name, its base, the start card, its slices, their slice requests, and how many of them are built side by side.

name.description: The wave's name, wave-<number>, which its combined branch and scratch worktrees are named after.

base.description: The head of into the plan was read at; every slice of the wave is cut from it.

card.description: The wave's start card: the plan and wave, each slice in two lines, how many builders work side by side, and what it costs in model calls at most.

lines.description: One line for each thing the card says, wrapped by the kernel to 44 columns.

mark.description: Every line of this card comes from a step that ran no skill.

words.description: What the owner reads, worked out by script.

step.description: The step of the wave that the line cites.

withheld.description: The reason for the go-ahead the start approval withholds, one full sentence.

slices.description: The wave's slices, in plan order.

requests.description: The slice requests, in plan order.

items.description: A slice request, in the form the workflow rounds takes.

sideBySide.description: How many slices are built at the same time: the setting sideBySide, or 2 when it is left out.

offered.description: Which go-ahead the start approval offers: build-over when an earlier run left branches of the wave, build otherwise.

leftovers.description: Each branch an earlier run of the wave left that may hold work, the slices' and the combined branch, with its commit; empty when there is none.

branch.description: The branch an earlier run left.

commit.description: The commit it points at, in full.

builtBefore.description: The design's actions the slices of the plan's earlier waves build, which are merged, as <interface>.<action>; empty when the plan names no design.
